Hi Sarah,

FYI, I’ve atill not heard anything regarding the prepaid return on my first
NerdQaxe but it may be good because I have to submit a warranty claim on a
second miner.

The problematic unit has exhibited the following issues:

   - Repeated unexpected reboots, including both *Task Watchdog Reset*
and *Software
   Panic Reset* errors.
   - An extended outage of approximately 13 hours during which the miner
   stopped submitting shares to the mining pool.
   - Intermittent dashboard and Settings pages that become stuck on
   “Loading.”
   - Periods where the miner reports 0 GH/s despite being powered on and
   connected to Wi-Fi.

Both miners are running the same firmware (v1.0.35), using their original
power supplies, and operating at factory frequency and voltage settings.
The other unit is functioning normally under comparable conditions.

Given the repeated failures and the fact that the unit is  new, I believe a
warranty replacement is warranted.

*I’d appreciate your authorization to return the defective unit for
replacement*, along with instructions for the return process and a prepaid
shipping label.

Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to resolving this promptly.
Kindly,

Tom

Tom

You are right to be angry, and I am not going to argue with any of it. Looking back through your history, the refunded 602 order, the oversold NerdQaxe++ and Supra, and now two of the three replacement units giving you trouble within days of landing on October 11, that is a poor run and you have been patient far longer than you should have had to be.

Here is where each of your three asks stands, honestly.

The return on the dead unit has been sitting for sign-off since October 14 and that is too long. I have put it in front of Georges and Abel this morning with the full history, and a colleague is picking it up today. The moment it is signed off, your prepaid label comes straight to you in this thread with the reference to write on the box. I will not tell you a replacement is shipping before that, because our warehouse releases it when your faulty unit reaches us, and I would rather give you the real sequence than a date that slips again.

On the second unit, our technician's read is that the watchdog and panic resets, the stuck dashboard and the 0 GH/s spells point to firmware rather than the board, which is why it has not gone down the same route as the dead one. I have asked JD to go back over the new detail you sent. The fastest way to reach him directly is our Discord, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, where he is @nullhashrate, and he will also come back to you here.

The $75 off $100 code and your request for something for the hashrate you have lost are both above what I can issue myself, so they are with Georges today and he will come back to you in this thread.

Sorry again for the run you have had, Tom.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
